Updated review: I made the mistake of letting a glitch go without reporting it. 

I’ve got two devices, three if I count my iPad and the app started only letting me log from one device. Which was annoying because app purchases are tied to the Apple ID, not the device. I kept putting off reporting this weird glitch this year until it finally stopped letting me track with the Pro Membership altogether this month. I’ve been a loyal subscriber since 2018.

Once I reported it to the App team this week, they immediately jumped on it. Couldn’t have been nicer and fixed it fast. I was so relieved. I apologize for thinking they were pulling something on me by making me buy the subscription again when I had had purchased a lifetime membership. Again, if you have a glitch- report it. 

Great app. Great people. Say something when it breaks. Don’t just shrug it off like I did.

I got the paid version of this app, because you can only track 5 criteria, I believe, with the free version. 

Here are the problems that I experienced that were not obvious from the description:
1. It does not track either body fat or lean muscle mass percentages. You have to figure that out for yourself and enter it. That required me to GOOGLE two different websites. I tried to back up in the data entry on the app to get my measurements, but that erased them. I had to remeasure myself, write them down, and enter them in the app, the body fat online calculator, and the muscle mass calculator I found. What an inconvenient, long drawn out process. 
2. The app requires the iPad to be in portrait mode for all data entry, not just taking the photos. It cannot toggle between landscape and portrait mode. That is difficult for people like me whose iPad is in a keyboard. If you turn it on its side, it might fall out. If you pop it out of the keyboard every single time you use the app, you’re going to wear out the anchoring tabs on he keyboard. Why in the world would they require this? 
3. You cannot choose a start date. If you know your starting weight from a week ago, but you go the app and entered your data today, your start date is today. You also cannot enter past data if you’ve been writing down your progress and want to transfer it to this app. 

I have only had this app for a few days, and am beginning to hate it. I’ll probably just delete it. Learn from my mistake and steer clear.

reviews.title: Perfect app found after deleting several others!
reviews.text:
I just started using this app but I can say, that I truly do love it already. It has everything I was looking for an after downloading and deleting several other apps, this one is a keeper! First, let me start by saying that when you have an issue, the app creator is incredibly responsive at addressing the issue or question you're having. The app itself is great. My favorite feature is actually one that I did not see highlighted in the description but that you actually can lock the app on your phone so that people can't arbitrarily look at your pictures or weight loss information. I went ahead and right away upgraded to the full version for the $4, i'm not sure what else it unlocked but it immediately got rid of the ads and allowed me to chart many more measurements. That alone was worth it for me. The app starts by letting you pick and choose exactly what measurements you'd like to track. They give you a relatively easy way to enter the numbers and then it will prompt you to take photos as well. It's very clear in telling you to take back front side views. And then it takes all this information and it categorizes it for you and allows you to access it through the tabs on the bottom. For me, when I'm feeling like I don't want to work out, I click on my Photos button and remind myself of why am doing this - trust me, this is very motivating vs having a phone picture you took of yourself that someone could happen upon or you could accidentally download and other people see it without you realizing it. Plus the photo is right away at your fingertips with one click so you're not searching for anything. As you enter your measurements, I love the fact that it breaks it down for you and does the math to tell you how close you are to your goal as well as what exactly was lost on each body part you measured. I find that motivating to see the actual progress. It does your progress in a few ways, you get a total inches tally that tabulates everything you measured into one big measurement and then it will document how many inches you lost off your total which I think is kind of nice. Then each body part is broken down separately and it has a very clear circle that's highlighted that shows you immediately how much you've lost without any calculations on your part. I haven't gotten to use it yet, but the photo comparison seems like it's going to be very motivating, it allows you to scroll through photos from different dates and show them side-by-side or even an overlay formation. Again, I was simply looking for something to help me track my progress, help keep me motivated to stay on track, and let me see results in an easy fashion. It's a bonus that it actually has a lock on it. For me, this app meets all my needs.

***update: I believe I figured out what happened with the one negative review for this app. I was reviewing my progress and since it was technically my day to "measure", I got excited as I spot checked one of the measurements just for fun and just naturally started moving the sliders and entering all my new numbers (all smaller BTW) and as I got to the last one, I realized I was actually overwriting the prior week . . . I was in the RESULTS tab under the prior date vs. where I needed to be which was the ADD RESULTS tab to make a new entry!!!! Operator error and had nothing to do with the app. Just be aware - it was a bummer not to be able to see my actual progress because of my error. Lesson learned.
